title: Plan class: feature ship (shared acceptance invariants)
description: The CLASS rubric feature-shipping plans' acceptance rubrics reference (acceptance-rubrics-on-every-plan-2026-08-11 D-006): the repo's shared completion invariants, encoded once so per-plan bespoke criteria stay at 3-7 outcome lines. Graded at plan completion by a NON-implementer.

criteria.title: Every committed outcome is observably true
criteria.model: Each outcome the plan's goal + Decisions commit to holds in the shipped system — criteria trace to the plan's stated GOAL, never merely to the diff.
criteria.method: Read the plan's Background/Design + Decisions; verify each committed outcome against the live system and its tests (plans:get the subject plan; exercise the behavior).
criteria.driftMarkers: Acceptance criteria that restate what was built instead of what the plan promised; a Decision's commitment with no verifying evidence.

criteria.title: Tests landed WITH the feature, in canonical frameworks
criteria.model: The feature's behavior is pinned by tests in one of the four canonical frameworks (Vitest / Playwright / Cargo / LLM scenarios), landed with the change — a passing typecheck is not a test.
criteria.method: Name the test files; run them (testing:run { files }) and confirm they exercise the NEW behavior, not just compile it.
criteria.driftMarkers: Green typecheck offered as test evidence; ad-hoc .mjs/tsx smoke scripts; tests promised as a follow-up.

criteria.title: Feature flag defaults ENABLED (no unregistered dark ship)
criteria.model: A gated feature's FLAGS entry defaults ON; default-OFF only for the registered dark-flag exceptions (incomplete / owner-authority / cutover), never for finished work awaiting a verify.
criteria.method: Read the flag's default in libs/flags/src/types.ts (derived FLAG_DEFAULTS) and confirm it is absent from KNOWN_DARK_FLAGS, or its dark entry carries a legitimate DarkCase.
criteria.driftMarkers: Built+tested+OFF; a runtime override ON while the types.ts default stays false; a parking-lot dark entry for finished work.

criteria.title: Live through the pipeline, not just edited in the tree
criteria.model: The change is committed, judged green by the checkpoint gate, and deployed — 'done' claims are made against the gate, not against tree edits or intent.
criteria.method: dev:pipeline_position { path } for a touched file: read blockedOn/nextAction and serving.startedSinceCodeChange; a red gate at ship time is the shipper's to green.
criteria.driftMarkers: 'Shipped' asserted from local edits; a red gate waited out or routed around; deploy assumed from a git fact.

criteria.title: Agent-facing docs and guidance updated
criteria.model: Docs, tool guidance, and prompts affected by the change say what the shipped system now does — a new durable surface is discoverable.
criteria.method: Check the surfaces the change touches: CLAUDE.md doc-parts, tool description/guidance, agent-insights runbooks; confirm none contradicts the shipped behavior.
criteria.driftMarkers: A new tool/table/flag with no doc trail; stale guidance steering agents into the old behavior.

criteria.title: The independent grader audits the audit
criteria.model: The independent grader opens a sample of the implementer's plan-audit citations and confirms each sampled code/test reference resolves against the current tree and actually supports the audited item — the audit verdict itself is never accepted as proof.
criteria.method: Read the subject plan's effective per-item audit. Spot-check at least one resolving code/test citation (and expand the sample after any mismatch): open the cited current blob, compare it with the item requirement and audit claim, and record what was checked. Treat doc, workitem, and none citations as declarations of non-verification, never substitutes for code truth.
criteria.driftMarkers: A grade copied from the audit's PASS label; no cited blob opened; a stale blob hash ignored; doc/work-item prose treated as proof that code exists.
